limits: No new product run, model call, checker execution, network or desktop action.
Scores use recorded numerator/denominator and receipts; raw artifacts are not regraded here.
Current source hashes do not imply historical seals pass; drift/missing bytes remain visible.
Source assertions and hashes are not third-party witness verification.
Model labels in B/W do not prove backend identity or same-model control.
Missing per-attempt versions/inputs/prompt equivalence remain unknown, never batch-backfilled.
Observation B/W rows never enter official n=1 table; stale raw IDs are preserved.
Prior r1028 three-case repeatability is not expanded into this five-case n3 index.
